source_history.summary: Implement the approved portable native orchestration plan across Codex, Cursor, Antigravity, and Grok Build.
Cursor pins latest verified Composer Standard for implementation and latest verified Grok base for research/review; no Fast or Auto.
Antigravity uses Gemini Flash through Pro at medium or higher, bans Gemini 3.6 Flash, and uses Claude high only for exceptional expert review.
Apply the new orchestration concepts during this implementation, reinstall all four platform runtimes, then commit and push main.

Current official/native sources confirm Codex standalone TOML agents under ~/.codex/agents, Antigravity custom agents under ~/.gemini/config/agents/<name>/agent.md, Cursor Composer 2.5 Standard must be distinguished from Fast, and unavailable host activation remains unverified.

acceptance.claim: Shared rules use portable capability classes, meaningful-question gates, main-direct limits, bounded context capsules, and risk-triggered expert review.
A single validated per-platform model policy encodes current allowed families, effort floors, hard-denied variants, and honest fallback evidence.
Ledger v3 records plan identity, execution authorization, host references, requested/resolved/observed model evidence, and main-direct exceptions with v2 migration.
workctl is callable from arbitrary projects after runtime installation and preserves existing lifecycle commands.
All four platforms receive native agent profiles that map portable roles to approved models without forbidden variants.
Unavailable or unobservable native capability degrades honestly to PARTIAL or approved fallback without a false model PASS.

reviews.scope: Benchmark oracle, all-platform release evidence, clean commit, and honest native activation boundaries
reviews.observed: Both oracle findings are resolved. P4-AC7-recovered and P4-AC8-final pass with matching artifact hashes; HEAD equals origin/main at e934053; mirrors and runtime state pass on all four; native activation remains explicitly UNVERIFIED.

findings.summary: Finalization can return WORK_PASS while current proof/review model evidence remains unobserved, contradicting the fail-honest model policy.
findings.resolution: Fresh independent stable-snapshot review plus focused regression and isolated all-platform installer/doctor evidence confirms the defect is fixed with no remaining finding.

findings.summary: Native profiles and model-policy.json are not copied into generated builds or installed runtime homes, so source-only profiles cannot affect hosts.
findings.resolution: Fresh independent stable-snapshot review plus focused regression and isolated all-platform installer/doctor evidence confirms the defect is fixed with no remaining finding.

findings.summary: Codex sources are CLI profiles rather than ~/.codex/agents custom subagents, and Grok role TOML uses ignored system_prompt fields instead of current native SubagentRole fields.
findings.resolution: Fresh independent stable-snapshot review plus focused regression and isolated all-platform installer/doctor evidence confirms the defect is fixed with no remaining finding.

findings.summary: Installed agent-rules-tools/workctl.py resolves the ledger schema through ROOT/automation, but the installed bundle places the schema beside workctl, so normal project init/status/resume/finalize cannot load it.
findings.resolution: Fresh independent stable-snapshot review plus focused regression and isolated all-platform installer/doctor evidence confirms the defect is fixed with no remaining finding.

findings.summary: First install overwrites generic pre-existing user agent filenames before ownership exists, and corrupt ownership manifest entries can traverse outside the destination during stale cleanup.
findings.resolution: Fresh independent stable-snapshot review plus focused regression and isolated all-platform installer/doctor evidence confirms the defect is fixed with no remaining finding.

findings.summary: Antigravity role guidance is installed to an inert advisory directory but is labeled and verified as a native agent definition instead of using the documented agents/<name>/agent.md discovery layout.
findings.resolution: Fresh independent stable-snapshot review plus focused regression and isolated all-platform installer/doctor evidence confirms the defect is fixed with no remaining finding.

findings.summary: Doctor excludes native artifacts from live hash checks and can finish without a blocking structural capability result when required native files are missing or corrupt.
findings.resolution: Fresh independent stable-snapshot review plus focused regression and isolated all-platform installer/doctor evidence confirms the defect is fixed with no remaining finding.

findings.summary: Native schema tests are repository allowlists and do not prove platform discovery layouts; they missed the Antigravity mapping and lack host validation evidence where CLIs are unavailable.
findings.resolution: Fresh independent stable-snapshot review plus focused regression and isolated all-platform installer/doctor evidence confirms the defect is fixed with no remaining finding.

findings.summary: No deterministic test proves that native role model and effort selections stay consistent with the single model-policy source.
findings.resolution: Fresh independent stable-snapshot review plus focused regression and isolated all-platform installer/doctor evidence confirms the defect is fixed with no remaining finding.

findings.summary: Shared rules restrict medium/large implementation to delegation but do not define the AC6 single-agent fallback when a host lacks callable subagents, which can reduce task strength or deadlock execution instead of preserving the plan sequentially.
findings.resolution: Fresh independent stable-snapshot review plus focused regression and isolated all-platform installer/doctor evidence confirms the defect is fixed with no remaining finding.

findings.summary: Fresh isolated end-to-end installer reaches doctor, but Test-NativeStructure passes a FileInfo object through a string-typed collection so Get-FileHash receives only the bare filename and crashes instead of verifying the installed native artifact.
findings.resolution: Fresh independent stable-snapshot review plus focused regression and isolated all-platform installer/doctor evidence confirms the defect is fixed with no remaining finding.

findings.summary: Cursor installer maps generated docs/ to .cursor/agent-rules-docs/, but doctor checks manifest docs/* under .cursor/docs/*, so every Cursor installation is reported missing and the full installer remains PARTIAL.
findings.resolution: Fresh independent stable-snapshot review plus focused regression and isolated all-platform installer/doctor evidence confirms the defect is fixed with no remaining finding.

findings.summary: The machine's available Windows PowerShell 5 enumerates single-item ConvertFrom-Json ownership arrays differently, producing false ownership mapping drift; full native install must work on the current supported machine rather than only pwsh.
findings.resolution: Fresh independent stable-snapshot review plus focused regression and isolated all-platform installer/doctor evidence confirms the defect is fixed with no remaining finding.

findings.summary: The release benchmark case live-normal-multifile exists in the corpus but has no executable fixture oracle, so native empirical validation aborts before launching Codex and cannot measure implementation behavior or token cost.
findings.resolution: Added an executable normal-multifile fixture oracle; corrected a style-sensitive false negative; the preserved native run passes behavioral rescoring with exact scope, exact consumer trace, four passing tests, and response evidence.
